post.summary: Queries a dataset, as a snapshot model is queried.
post.description: The body's `kind` is the operation: `list` (an array, or with `Accept: text/event-stream` one `row` event per record), `paged`, `cursor`, `single`, `count` or `aggregate` (an array of groups). A streamed `list` is resumable: each `row` event's `id` is the record's position, an opaque cursor token; the stream reads keyset chunks, bounded by time and query permits rather than rows, and ends with an `end` event `{"reason", "resumable"}` (`complete`, or the resumable `hold-expired`, `permit-reclaimed` and `node-stopping`); the same request with `Last-Event-ID` continues strictly after that position. Chunks are not one snapshot: a record written meanwhile is read when it sorts after the position. A list whose sort cannot order a cursor (or a model whose descriptor says `record.stream.resumable: false`) streams without `id`s, and every `end` it sends says `"resumable": false`.

200.description: The query's answer, by its kind.

x-wow-events.id: The record's position: send it as `Last-Event-ID` to resume after it.

304.description: Not Modified: the descriptor is at the version If-None-Match names.

wow.Manifest.title: Wow Manifest
wow.Manifest.description: A service's Manifest, or a module's fragment (without service), format 1.

requires.description: The markers a reader must understand to read the Manifest.

errors.description: The framework's error codes and their HTTP statuses.

$defs.description: The JSON Schema 2020-12 of every payload, by key.

wow.Manifest.Service.description: The service a merged Manifest describes; a fragment has none.

wow.Manifest.Context.description: A bounded context: its aggregates, subscriptions, published streams, error codes and job commands.

name.description: The bounded context's name: lower case words joined by hyphens.

commands.description: The context's own system commands: its job commands.

routes.description: The context's service routes, whose handlers are its own code.

wow.Manifest.ServiceRoute.description: A service route: a route whose handler is the service's own code, its parameters and schemas.

name.description: The route's name in its context: its identity and its client's method.

request.description: An inline JSON Schema: a $ref into $defs, or an array of one.

response.description: An inline JSON Schema: a $ref into $defs, or an array of one.

errors.description: The codes the route refuses with, entries of the context's errors.

wow.Manifest.RouteParameter.description: A path variable or query parameter of a service route, and its scalar schema.

in.description: Where the parameter is read from.

schema.description: An inline JSON Schema of a scalar.

wow.Manifest.Aggregate.description: An aggregate type: its state, snapshots, commands, events and query models.

ownership.description: Who owns an aggregate; owner when absent.

retired.description: The events the aggregate no longer produces.

idSource.description: Where an aggregate's id comes from; assigned when absent.

wow.Manifest.State.description: An aggregate's state: its schema, the fingerprint of its shape and, in a contract, its view.

wow.Manifest.Snapshot.description: Whether an aggregate keeps snapshots, and the revision of their state.

wow.Manifest.Query.description: A query model of an aggregate (snapshot, events) and its routes.

wow.Manifest.Command.description: A command of an aggregate or a context, and the routes that send it.

creation.description: Whether the command creates its aggregate.

produces.description: The events the command produces, when the module says.

system.description: A system command (wow.*): a lifecycle command, a rebuild or a job command.

wow.Manifest.Event.description: An event of an aggregate and its revision.

wow.Manifest.Route.description: A route of the edge: a method and a path, {id} the aggregate id.

wow.Manifest.Error.description: An error code, the HTTP status it is answered with, and what a retry may do.

retry.description: What a retry may do, as a problem of the code says: none when left out.

retryAfter.description: The seconds to wait before a retry, the problem's Retry-After; given with retry.

wow.Manifest.Published.description: A stream a context publishes of an aggregate's events, and its topic.

wow.Manifest.Subscription.description: A subscription of a bounded context: what it reads and what its handler derives.

wow.Manifest.Source.description: What a subscription reads: a context, aggregate types and events.

wow.Manifest.Function.description: The handler function of a subscription.

wow.Manifest.Job.description: The scheduled job a subscription runs.

misfire.description: What the job does with the slots it missed.

wow.Snapshot.description: An aggregate's snapshot as a query and a state read return it; a projection leaves fields out.

schedules.description: The schedules the aggregate keeps, each rule by its key.

wow.EventStream.description: An event stream, the commit of one command: `ownerId`, `spaceId` and `operator` are null when unset; a projection leaves fields out.

wow.QueryRequest.description: A query: its `kind`, and the members of that kind's query.

filter.description: A filter expression of the query protocol.

wow.PagedList.description: One page; `total` is null when the query asked for no total, and a lower bound when `exact` is false.

wow.CursorPage.description: One page of a cursor; `nextCursor` is null after the last.

wow.QueryDescriptor.description: What the query model can do on the backend the node runs: operations, fields and limits.

wow.schedule.Enable.description: Creates, or enables again, the job instance of the path's id, the job's name in the caller's tenant.

wow.schedule.Reschedule.description: Overrides the instance's rule; null follows the job's default again.

wow.schedule.JobRule.description: An instance's own rule of a job; each part that is null follows the job's default.

wow.snapshot.Rebuild.description: Rebuilds from the log the snapshots of the aggregates `ids` of the route's aggregate type, in the caller's tenant.

context.name: context
context.description: The context the dataset belongs to.

dataset.name: dataset
dataset.description: The dataset's name in its context.

Wow-Request-Id.name: Wow-Request-Id
Wow-Request-Id.description: The caller's id of the request, kept as the command's request id: a retry with the same one is deduplicated.

Wow-Wait.name: Wow-Wait
Wow-Wait.description: The wait plan: hops separated by `>`, each `accepted`, `committed`, `snapshot` or `handled(subscription)`, with an optional `(context)`, such as `handled(order/payment-saga) > committed(inventory)`. Without it the command waits for its snapshot.

Wow-Wait-Timeout.name: Wow-Wait-Timeout
Wow-Wait-Timeout.description: How long to wait: `500ms`, `10s`, `1m` or an ISO-8601 duration (`PT10S`).

Wow-Scope.name: Wow-Scope
Wow-Scope.description: The scope to act in, for a caller allowed to act across scopes: an RFC 8941 dictionary. On a query route, `tenant=*` or an inner list of tenants reads across tenants when `wow.query.allow-cross-tenant` is on.

Wow-Space.name: Wow-Space
Wow-Space.description: The space, among the caller's own, to act in.

traceparent.name: traceparent
traceparent.description: The W3C trace context of the caller's span: the command's admission continues the trace.

tracestate.name: tracestate
tracestate.description: The W3C trace state that goes with `traceparent`.

baggage.name: baggage
baggage.description: The W3C baggage that goes with `traceparent`.

If-Match.name: If-Match
If-Match.description: The version the aggregate is expected at, as an entity tag: `"3"`. A mismatch is 412.

If-None-Match.name: If-None-Match
If-None-Match.description: The entity tag the client holds: 304 when it is still the current one.

Last-Event-ID.name: Last-Event-ID
Last-Event-ID.description: Resumes a streamed `list` strictly after this position, the `id` of the last `row` event read: send the same query body again. A position of another model or sort is `wow.query.invalid`.

version.name: version
version.description: Reads the state at this version.

at.name: at
at.description: Reads the state after the last commit at or before this ISO-8601 instant.

minVersion.name: minVersion
minVersion.description: Reads the latest state at this version or later, a command result's version, so a client reads its own writes; not with version or at.

from.name: from
from.description: The first version of the trace; 1 by default.

to.name: to
to.description: The last version of the trace; the last by default.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: The most commits the trace holds; 100 by default.

ETag.description: The entity tag of the representation, which If-None-Match names to be answered 304.

Retry-After.description: The seconds after which the request may be retried.
